content_text: In reply to the original question about Blain Brown, I can recommend his books as they contain a lot of technical detail which most books these do not, many of the books on the market claim to provide a wealth of information but contain very little, mostly are written by vanity publishers and charge massive price which amounts to daylight robbery.  However, I can recommend Blain Brown as a worthy author even though they are still expensive but they are worth it imo.
